hypotheses.falsifier: (1) a path commit carries only its own journal lines: record A unstaged, `git commit -- B`, the committed entry for A is HEAD's and for B the working one; (2) a reseal forced to ENOSPC after one seal, under `git commit -- <source>`, lands the commit, prints COULD NOT RUN, and every committed journal entry's sha_after matches its committed blob; (3) the working-tree journal is byte-identical before and after the check
hypotheses.piece: check_staged composes the committed journal per path, so a commit carries only its own records' journal lines
